messages.text: Project team needs one defensible decision for work-order project attribution by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside project ID, task ID, contract line, open work order, and effective date.
I found 3 RECORDS on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for remaining order window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R8 and the CASE-079 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-078.
